# Business Santa

> Business Santa (https://www.businesssanta.com) helps small businesses across the United States show up on Google search, Google Maps and AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity. It is the client-facing brand of SEO Season (https://seoseason.com), the SEO and AI search intelligence platform built by founder Manav S. A real team does the work: Jyoti (Client Success Lead), Manav S (founder; strategy and AI search), Sam (technical SEO) and Sakshi (content and on-page SEO).

## Key facts
- What it does: local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, Google Maps ranking, technical SEO and Google Search Console fixes, on-page SEO, WordPress and Yoast SEO, Shopify SEO, monthly SEO, and AI search optimization (GEO and AEO).
- Who it serves: small and local businesses in all 50 US states, including plumbers, dentists, roofers, law firms, restaurants, salons and spas, and retail stores.
- Free check: a real person checks how a business shows up on Google, Google Maps and ChatGPT and sends a short plain-English report with the top 3 fixes. No card, no contract.
- Prices: free check $0; on-page SEO fixes from $120; technical SEO fixes from $160; monthly, Shopify, AI search and full packages quoted after the free check.
- Experience: founder Manav S has 10+ years in SEO and 2,000+ projects delivered, with a 4.9 average rating from client reviews.
- How it works: clients approve every change first, see every change, and check results in their own Google Business Profile and Google Search Console. No long contracts.
- Team location: India. Work happens while US clients sleep, prices stay fair, and the team talks with clients by WhatsApp, email and Zoom.
- Honesty policy: no guaranteed #1 rankings. Google says no one can guarantee them.
- Contact: seo@businesssanta.com, WhatsApp +91 70097 75189, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/businesssanta, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/businesssanta, Crunchbase https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/business-santa, Clutch https://clutch.co/profile/business-santa
